summaries.Oral reading: Read aloud in the printed order. Pronounce words clearly and pause at punctuation. Teachers assess accuracy and fluency; the printed text is the oral response.
summaries.Dictation: Listen to the supplied teacher text and identify the exact detail asked for. Check spelling and sentence punctuation; missing scripts are explicitly identified.
summaries.Picture vocabulary: Observe the pictured object or action. Name its identifying features and use correct spelling; action sentences use is or are with an ing verb.
summaries.Compound words: Use sentence meaning, subject agreement and time clues to choose the word or verb form. Apply the specific rule explained for each task and note ambiguous choices.
summaries.Capital letters: Follow a clear sequence and keep the tense consistent. Introduce people and events before their pronouns, actions and final outcome.
